normative_text.comparison: All textual RR rules in Ch.1-Ch.3 match the 2018 NIKL compilation except Ch.3 art.6 updates the category term 문화재명 to 국가유산명; current law page renders tables/examples as images, so fixture examples are transcribed from the 2018 NIKL official compilation with per-case source references retained for rule-parity checks.
normative_text.reuse_basis: Regulatory examples reproduce state-issued language notices, covered by Korean Copyright Act Article 7(2), and the state compilation of those notices, Article 7(4). Additional pronunciation cases record short factual word/pronunciation pairs with independently written notes. NIKL explanatory prose and document layout are not reproduced.
